Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to my role in the accident, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were sitting when the collision happened?
A: I was in the front passenger seat of my friend's sedan. We were stopped at a red light on the main road in
Pasadena, Texas, when a pickup truck hit us from behind.
Q: Did you see the pickup coming before the impact?
A: Not really. I was looking at my phone. I heard tires squealing for a second and then the jolt came. My head
snapped forward and then back.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was buckled in the whole time.
Q: Tell me about your injuries. Where did you feel pain first?
A: My right knee hit the dashboard. It swelled up pretty fast, and by that evening I could barely bend it. My neck and
upper back were sore too, but the knee is the worst of it.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They took X-rays and told me to see an orthopedic doctor. I have
an appointment set up for next week.
Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement in the knee?
A: Yes. Stairs are hard, and I'm using a brace when I walk for longer distances. I've had to take time off work because
standing for long shifts is too painful.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident or your injuries?
A: Just that I want to make sure the other driver's insurance knows I'm taking this seriously. I'm still working through
the medical side of things.
Q: Understood. Thank you for your time today.
A: You're welcome.
</page>
